text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Do it: Build a self-review loop where each prompt engine auto-runs a quality check on its own outputs before routing to the next stage. This cuts downstream fixes by catching errors early and keeps the system honest without adding human review steps. Trade-off: it adds a small compute cost per cycle, but the time saved in debugging outweighs it.
